crossRefs.keyword: by himself. Heb. with his body

translations.web: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
translations.bsb: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
translations.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out
translations.asv: If he come in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he be married, then his wife shall go out with him.
